name: B2BGuard Hide Price
author: manapoint

sections.description:
B2BGuard Hide Price is a high-performance, ultra-lightweight plugin designed for WooCommerce store owners who need a clean solution to hide prices and manage B2B quotes.

Unlike heavy, bloated B2B suites, this plugin is strictly single-purpose and weighs less than 30kb. It operates with zero dependencies (no jQuery, no React, no external form builders) by leveraging modern vanilla JavaScript and the native HTML5 element.

🚀 DISCOVER THE PRO VERSION: Bulk Activation & B2B Fields

Do you want to manage a professional B2B catalog without wasting time and by collecting real data? We created B2BGuard Hide Price & B2B Quote PRO for the most demanding merchants.

The PRO version includes:

  • Bulk Category Activation: Enable the quote module on entire product categories with a single click, without having to manually edit every single product.
  • Advanced Mandatory B2B Fields: Collect real business data such as Company Name, VAT number, and Phone directly in the form.
  • Backend Mini-CRM (CPT): Don’t risk losing leads via email. Save all requests in a dedicated private panel within the WordPress backend.
  • Zero Subscriptions (Buy Once, Use Forever): Pay once, no monthly fees, technical support included for 12 months.

👉 Discover the PRO version on Manapoint

LITE Features

  • Selective B2B Mode: Toggle the quote system on a per-product basis using a native WooCommerce backend checkbox.
  • Smart Price Hiding: Completely hides prices and disables purchasing (“Add to Cart”) for guest users and standard customers on selected products.
  • Email Lead Capture: Injects a “Request B2B Quote” button and a modal form that sends requests directly to the administrator’s email.
  • Performance First: Conditional asset loading and PHP memoization for extreme efficiency.

External services

This plugin does not use any third-party or external services. All request processing is handled locally within your WordPress installation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the b2bguard-hide-price folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the .zip file directly via the WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Edit any WooCommerce product and check the “Enable B2B Quote” box.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Full compatibility with WordPress 7.0.
  • Official declaration of WooCommerce HPOS compatibility.
  • Improved HTML output security and quote form escaping.
  • Added WC_Product integrity checks for price and purchase filters.
  • Asset version synchronization (v1.0.1).

1.0.0

  • Initial LITE release.
  • Isolated version from PRO.
  • Removed CPT and database storage.
  • Simplified AJAX handler to email-only mode.
  • Updated all prefixes and handles for total isolation.
